title:
P0 · AI · Done — Auto routing for debug/analysis, manual override; always-Haiku complaint

Fixed classifier output budget (32 → 128 tokens). Live Bedrock Auto chose Opus and completed a debugging answer; routine lookup chose Haiku. Manual overrides and offline regressions passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45411134828

P0 · Analysis · Done — Comprehensive large-file/PR reviews

Pinned line/column readers, full PR manifests, merge-base versions, explicit gaps and encrypted resumable checkpoints. Live GitHub/model checks and Linux/Windows/browser CI passed. Source/API/model limits remain explicit; a read is not a correctness verdict.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45415024500

P0 · Memory · Done — Restart continuity, carry previous knowledge, global project context, hold context until asked

Encrypted reference briefs, project/subgroup recall, relevant Diary notes, full saved-text paging and continued-review checkpoints. Restart/window/privacy/browser checks passed, including live model recall after 18 later turns. Saved references are not current verified facts.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45422422473

P0 · Security · Done — Data safety for chats, diary, tasks, secrets and configuration

SQLCipher chats, Diary, tasks and search; protected password; Windows DPAPI key. Migration preserved every saved-record count and verified protected credentials. Interrupted migration, encrypted restore and Linux/Windows/browser checks passed. CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45428297613

P0 · Privacy · Done — Ultra privacy for tokens/passwords

Full database encryption plus session vault reauthentication, 5-minute expiry, Lock now/tab-hide locking, per-entry AI opt-in and live per-read lock checks. Windows/Linux/browser workflow passed: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45431479032

P0 · Access · Done — Further role/access improvements

Server roles and isolated accounts plus live session, expiry, revocation and role-change checks throughout model/tool/HTTP requests; resource cleanup verified. Enterprise SSO and cross-account project sharing remain optional future integrations. CI passed: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45437361523

P0 · UI bug · Done — To-do Show more not working

Browser regression verified expand/collapse, multiline detail and visible Copy/Edit/Delete controls.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45411134828

P1 · Speed · Done — Performance improvement

Independent read rounds run at concurrency 4 with ordered results, single-flight duplicate reuse, cancellation and sequential writes. Windows TLS initialization moved off the event loop. Offline benchmark measured 3.98x scheduling speedup and 96.31% repeated-evidence reduction; actual network latency varies. Windows/Linux/browser CI passed: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45439006885

P1 · Efficiency · Done — Token optimization

Historical evidence compacted with full saved-record paging; encrypted immutable GitHub snapshots expire after five minutes, invalidate on scope/token rotation and disclose verification time. Mutable sources and fresh/private requests bypass snapshots.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45445074986

P1 · Usage · Done — Bill details; day/model usage dashboard

Day/model ledger now includes billable connection tests and incomplete-call notices, cache-aware prices, monthly UTC warn/stop budgets and manual invoice comparisons. Unknown usage and other clients cannot be capped; provider invoice retrieval is not available with an inference key.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45446415311

P1 · Attachments · Done — Files and pasted screenshots

Validated document/ZIP ingestion, Office/PDF text, scanned PDF images, encrypted conversation-scoped full-text paging/search, large paste cards and restart/private isolation passed CI. Six attachments/four images, explicit size/archive bounds; unsupported binaries are metadata-only, not silently interpreted.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45448311966

P1 · Validation · Done — Attachment size/formats; huge paste becomes attachment

Validated document/ZIP ingestion, Office/PDF text, scanned PDF images, encrypted conversation-scoped full-text paging/search, large paste cards and restart/private isolation passed CI. Six attachments/four images, explicit size/archive bounds; unsupported binaries are metadata-only, not silently interpreted.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45448311966

P1 · Concurrency · Done — Multiple asks in parallel

Three separate chats can answer concurrently with isolated conversation IDs/live views and a Stop button scoped to the visible chat. Server enforces three streams per workspace and one per conversation. Cancellation, navigation and CSP-compatible browser regressions passed Windows/Linux/browser CI.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45451165844

P1 · Code · WIP — Modular code and useful logging

Separate storage, connectors, routing, memory, access and attachment modules; server logs and audit exist. main.py and app.js remain large; structured tracing/performance telemetry is planned.

P1 · GitHub · WIP — On 404, ask to add repository if appropriate

Repo-add proposal validates access before confirmation; scope/auth errors have hints. No deterministic 404-to-add flow. A 404 can also mean nonexistent or inaccessible data.

P1 · Files · Done — Validate/extract/search/analyse ZIP

Validated document/ZIP ingestion, Office/PDF text, scanned PDF images, encrypted conversation-scoped full-text paging/search, large paste cards and restart/private isolation passed CI. Six attachments/four images, explicit size/archive bounds; unsupported binaries are metadata-only, not silently interpreted.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45448311966

P1 · Maintenance · Planned — Cleanup unused files with dependency checks

Chat/record deletion exists; no dependency-aware file cleanup workflow.

P2 · Access · Done — Developer/end-user, view and reviewed execute modes

Backend read/write rules, administrator-only actions/config controls, confirmed writes and account isolation tests. Personal notes/connection settings remain editable in read-only service roles.

P2 · Access · Done — Admin/read-write-config; developer/read-write; viewer/read

Four roles: admin, developer, viewer, reviewer. External service writes are restricted by role plus the global write switch and confirmation.

P2 · Login · Done — Who are you? Reviewer / End-user choices

Role picker, issued access credentials and secondary authenticator flow; production requires OTP, local dev bypass is loopback-only.

P2 · Vault · Done — Password vault, optional AI access

Encrypted entries, per-entry AI sharing off by default, admin UI and redacted stored outputs; tested.

P2 · Organization · Done — Single chats, projects/modules/groups/subgroups

Separate conversations and nested organization; creation/move/validation tests. Cross-chat reuse is Partial above.

P2 · Organization · Done — Key/value personal records, pin/export/move chats

My Diary records, pinning, Markdown/text export, copying and chat movement.

P2 · Organization · Done — Move whole project/group with its contents

Subtree move preserves chats, diary records and children within a workspace. Cross-account workspace transfer is not provided.

P2 · Validation · Done — Maximum subgroup depth

Eight levels; cycle, duplicate-name and move-depth validation with tests.

P2 · Diary · Done — Separate visual key/value view

My Diary cards/view and editor; persisted scoped records.

P2 · Tasks · Done — To-do section

Add/edit/delete/complete/filter/copy; multiline text preserved. Expansion issue is separately Partial.

P2 · Identity · Done — At Your Service branding

Login and sidebar branding use the requested text.

P2 · Usage UI · Done — Burning-token emoji

Compact Auto/token badge; expanded model/token details.

P2 · Feedback · Done — Positive/negative, useful feedback form

Rating, category, comment and restricted feedback log; saved-answer validation.

P2 · Conversations · Done — First-message title and rename

Automatic first-message title; persistent rename; edits preserve chat identity/group.

P2 · Icons · Done — Topic emoji, default/custom emoji and monogram

Topic defaults, searchable presets, pasted custom emoji and 1–3 character monogram.

P2 · Conversations · Done — Archive chats

Archive/unarchive, archived view and persistence tests.

P2 · Administration · Done — Rename/restrict Action history

Audit log inside Admin settings; visible to administrator/developer, denied to viewer/reviewer.

P2 · Rendering · Done — Colourful code/JSON/YAML

Theme-aware syntax highlighting and exact-text code copy; 9 rendering tests passed.

P2 · Help · Done — FAQ

Basic troubleshooting FAQ, quick guide and shortcuts exist. Larger searchable knowledge/support content would be additional scope.

P3 · Prompting · Planned — Reusable favourite words/prompts

My Diary can store text manually; no dedicated prompt-snippet library/insertion UI.

P3 · Analysis · WIP — Analysis templates and skills

Response format guidance and structured Markdown/components exist. No reusable analysis-template/skill registry or selected template workflow.

P3 · Tasks · Planned — To-do type column

Current task fields: ID, title, completed, created, updated. No type/category column.

P3 · Icons · Planned — Change monogram colour

Colour follows theme/CSS; no per-icon colour picker/storage.

P3 · Composer · Planned — B/U/I, colour, indentation, tables, panels, etc.

Composer is a plain textarea; rendered answers support Markdown. No rich-text authoring toolbar.

P3 · Service · Planned — Another level of user assistance

Recommendations below; no dedicated new service layer implemented.
